GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

2. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.

3. Which statement about Glaciation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Glaciation as rumours only.
   B. Say Glaciation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Glaciation.
   D. Explain Glaciation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Trade as rumours only.
   B. Say Trade never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Trade.
   D. Explain Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Lakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Lakes.
   B. Treat Lakes as rumours only.
   C. Say Lakes never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Lakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Fishing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Fishing never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Fishing as rumours only.
   C. Explain Fishing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing.

7. Which statement about Action of wind and water in arid areas is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Action of wind and water in arid areas with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Action of wind and water in arid areas.
   C. Treat Action of wind and water in arid areas as rumours only.
   D. Say Action of wind and water in arid areas never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Oceans, Seas and Coasts is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Oceans, Seas and Coasts as rumours only.
   B. Explain Oceans, Seas and Coasts with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Oceans, Seas and Coasts.
   D. Say Oceans, Seas and Coasts never happens in Kenya.

9. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

11. Which statement about Karst Scenery is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Karst Scenery as rumours only.
   B. Say Karst Scenery never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Karst Scenery.
   D. Explain Karst Scenery with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   C. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Elementary Surveying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Action of wind and water in arid areas and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. D — Plan income and spending wisely

2. A — Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. D — Explain Glaciation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. D — Explain Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. D — Explain Lakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. C — Explain Fishing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. A — Explain Action of wind and water in arid areas with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. B — Explain Oceans, Seas and Coasts with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. D — Explain symbols used on a map

10. D — Nairobi

11. D — Explain Karst Scenery with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. C — Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Statistical Methods; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Elementary Surveying; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Geographic Information Systems; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Action of wind and water in arid areas; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
